findings.title: Webhook endpoint without authentication
findings.message: Webhook node has authentication set to 'none'. Anyone who can reach the n8n instance can trigger this workflow and its downstream actions.
findings.remediation: Set Webhook > Authentication to Basic/Header/JWT auth, or validate a shared-secret header in the workflow before doing anything sensitive.

findings.title: Code node without sandbox hardening
findings.message: Code node present (mode=runOnceForAllItems). Custom code runs inside n8n; in 'runOnceForAllItems' JS mode with task runners disabled it can reach the host environment.
findings.remediation: Enable N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true (task runners sandbox), keep code reviewed in version control, and avoid importing os/child_process.

findings.title: Code node without sandbox hardening
findings.message: Code node present (mode=runOnceForAllItems). Custom code runs inside n8n; in 'runOnceForAllItems' JS mode with task runners disabled it can reach the host environment.
findings.remediation: Enable N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true (task runners sandbox), keep code reviewed in version control, and avoid importing os/child_process.

findings.title: Missing error handling on workflow
findings.message: Workflow has no errorWorkflow setting and no Error Trigger node. Failures (and the data inside them) go nowhere visible.
findings.remediation: Attach an error workflow in Settings > Error Workflow, or add an Error Trigger workflow that alerts a human.

findings.title: Webhook response mode exposes internals
findings.message: Webhook responseMode='lastNode' - the last node's full output (possibly including credentials, internal IDs, stack traces) is returned to the unauthenticated caller.
findings.remediation: Return an explicit minimal payload via the Respond to Webhook node.

findings.title: Execute Command node without guardrails
findings.message: Execute Command node runs an expression-built command ({{...}}) - workflow data flows into a shell.
findings.remediation: Replace with dedicated nodes, pin an exact static command, run n8n in a restricted container, and require authenticated triggers upstream.
findings.evidence:
=#!/bin/bash

# Get library name from variable
LIBRARY_NAME="{{$json.library}}"

findings.title: Expression-based command injection
findings.message: Command is built from workflow data ($json/$node expressions). Upstream attacker-controlled content becomes shell metacharacters.
findings.remediation: Never interpolate data into commands; use argv-style APIs or strict allowlist validation of the entire command string.

findings.title: Credential reuse across many nodes
findings.message: Credential 'httpBasicAuth' is used by 5 nodes in one workflow. A single prompt-injection or SSRF pivot exposes all of them.
findings.remediation: Split workflows by trust boundary and scope credentials per workflow.
